models_evaluated: rule-based CDSS algorithm for NLCSP eligibility

links.outcome: Availability of PLCOm2012 input variables in general practice EMRs
links.effect: In 933 audited records, missing data were education 100%, ethnicity 58%, BMI 57%, daily cigarette consumption 33%; pack-years calculable for only 17.2% of 1,315 records.
links.quote: A subset of 933 records was assessed for PLCOm2012 variables, revealing substantial data gaps (% missing): education level (100 %), ethnicity (58 %), BMI (57 %), and daily cigarette consumption (33 %).

screen.reason: The study deploys a CDSS rule-based tool and evaluates data readiness and missingness for the PLCOm2012 risk prediction model in live general practice EMRs, examining the feasibility and safeguards needed before risk-model implementation.

primary.practice: data quality audit for risk model implementation
